none: PAS CAM-6E0452: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus, Constans as Augustus, AD 340-341.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ CONSTAN S PF AVG

Copper alloy Nummus, Constans as Augustus, AD 340-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse: two soldiers and one standard. Mint: Trier or Arles AD 340. See RIC VIII, c.f. p.145, no.206. Obverse legend reads: CONSTAN S PF AVG. Obverse: Laureate and rosette diademed bust facing right. Die axis 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.58g, diameter is 13.8mm
